titulo: Watch Out GTA 6, A Shrek 2 Remaster Was Just Announced
texto: A remaster of 2004's Shrek 2: The Game is on the way, according to an Xbox.com listing that was published too soon. Following the leak, Aspyr officially announced the Shrek 2 remaster, and it's releasing on November 10. That's just 9 days before GTA 6, so this November it's a battle of Shrek vs. GTA. Shrek 2 Remastered is releasing November 10 for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, Switch, and PC, price at $30. People who prepurchase can get it for $27. Like the original PS2, Xbox, and GameCube game, the remaster lets you play solo or in co-op with up to three friends, locally or online. The playable characters include Shrek, Fiona, and Donkey, among others. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6qjCMqy1fAk In addition to the updated graphics, the Shrek 2 remaster includes a new Photo Mode and Cheat Mode. titulo: Xbox Series X|S Is Getting A Surprise Graphics Boost From AMD
texto: Sony isn't the only company introducing new upscaling technology to its flagship PlayStation 5, as Microsoft and AMD have announced that FSR 4.1 is coming to more devices--including Xbox Series X|S consoles--in the future. Similar to Sony's hardware-accelerated upscaling solutions for PS5 and PS5 Pro, AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR) 4.1 is an advanced, machine-learning-based temporal image upscaling and reconstruction technology that can render a game at a lower resolution and then upscale it to a higher resolution. While it's highly doubtful that Xbox Series X|S consoles will start offering PS5 Pro-like graphics (both consoles lack dedicated hardware for machine-learning algorithms), this should still give owners a noticeable bump in graphical quality and performance if implemented properly. titulo: Sony Boss: “Creativity Is For Humans, Not AI”
texto: Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick and Sony Group President and CEO, Hiroki Totoki, commented on the future of gaming today at the Paley International Summit. Naturally, the topic of AI came up, and Totoki believes AI technologies will not replace humans in game development, in part because of the creativity required. "Creativity is for humans, not AI,” Totoki said, as reported by IGN . “How to use the technology profile is important. Of course, I encourage my people to use AI in a certain manner, but at [the] same time we try to keep the rights and rights holders and creators and artists.” For his part, Zelnick said it's his belief that AI itself will not replace a developer, but instead, people who don't embrace AI might be replaced by people who do. titulo: GTA 5 And Red Dead Redemption 2 Are Leaving PS Plus, But You Still Have Time
texto: While a whole bunch of new games are being added to the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog this month, it looks like Sony is making room for them by removing several titles over the next few weeks. We don’t know exactly when they will be gone, but you can expect 11 games to be removed over the next couple of weeks, including two of Rockstar's biggest open-world adventures: Red Dead Redemption 2 and Grand Theft Auto 5 . We've known for a while that GTA 5 was on its way out , but it looks like Rockstar and Take-Two Interactive are making sure there are no distractions for the November 19 launch of GTA 6. It's worth noting that both games have been in and out of the PS Plus Game Catalog, so they'll probably be added back at some point in the future.
